mainEntity.name: Should I add a full or half primary bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between adding a full or half primary bathroom depends on your specific needs, available space, and budget. A full bathroom includes a toilet, sink, and a shower or tub, offering complete functionality. A half bathroom, with just a toilet and sink, is more compact and less expensive but provides less utility. A practical tradeoff to consider is the amount of square footage you are willing to dedicate versus the desired functionality and impact on resale value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choosing between a full or half primary bathroom depends on your needs, space, and budget. A full bath offers complete utility, while a half bath is more compact and less costly.
